description_en: Copies all policies from a source virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall policy group to a destination VPC firewall policy group
description_zh: 从源VPC边界防火墙策略组拷贝所有策略到目标VPC边界防火墙策略组
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw batch-copy-vpc-firewall-control-policy --source-vpc-firewall-id vfw-a42bbb7b887148c90000 --target-vpc-firewall-id vfw-e37d3a04cf79446a0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchCopyVpcFirewallControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the access control policy group for the source virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall of this operation. Valid values:

If the VPC firewall protects traffic between a network instance in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance (network instances include VPCs, VBRs, and CCNs) and a specified VPC, the policy group ID is the CEN instance ID.

If the VPC firewall protects traffic between two VPCs that are connected through Express Connect, the policy group ID is the VPC firewall instance ID.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh:
该操作的源VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略组ID。取值：

VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网内的网络实例（网络实例包含VPC、VBR和CCN）和指定VPC之间的互访流量时，策略组ID使用云企业网实例ID。

VPC边界防火墙防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的流量时，策略组ID使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: source_vpc_firewall_id
